selection_policy: Balanced mechanical expansion for CWE-78 command injection: 100 cases selected from expectedresults order (50 vulnerable, 50 safe). This is a larger-scope stress test, not a hand-curated abstraction corpus.

cases.rationale: Balanced 100-case CWE-78 expansion selected from OWASP expectedresults order; used to stress-test command-injection scoring and CodeQL semantic equivalence.
